description: New workspace containers shall use the host timezone through Podman --tz=local
notes: The clock is shared with the host; recreate containers after host timezone changes; applications may override their timezone.

description: Existing OpenAI stdio tunnel shall remain available alongside generalized HTTP transports
notes: Tunnel IDs persist per workspace in host identity state while the runtime API key stays in Secret Service; each workspace resolves its own tunnel for parallel use.

description: Interactive tunnel starts shall list previously used tunnels with stable numbers and local in-use state and offer new-ID entry
notes: The registry stays in host-only secret state; remote names refresh through the tunnel client read-only admin tunnels get lookup
column13: while list/create/delete require an admin key.

description: Selecting a tunnel that another local workspace runs shall require confirmation and stop the other runtime first
notes: OpenAI supports one active stdio tunnel-client per tunnel ID; only local containers can be detected and stopped.

description: CLI shall expose Winx Streamable HTTP through a stable host-loopback-only port
notes: The container listener is mapped only to 127.0.0.1 on the host.

description: Each workspace shall reuse a strong bearer API key across MCP container restarts
notes: Default storage is under the host AI Sandbox secrets tree and is independent of sandbox home storage.

description: The persistent API key shall never be mounted into the MCP container or appear in process arguments
notes: Winx reads a transient token file at startup and that file is then removed.

description: A remotely managed Cloudflare tunnel shall publish a stable HTTPS MCP URL through an outbound-only connection
notes: Named tunnel token and public URL persist only in host secret storage.

description: CLI shall offer an explicit temporary Quick Tunnel for development without presenting it as stable registration
notes: Quick Tunnel URLs change and are not suitable for register-once integrations.

description: Remote publishing shall require no inbound router port forwarding or host listener
notes: Cloudflared runs inside the MCP container and initiates the public connection outward.

description: Separate workspaces shall have independent containers credentials runtime state and local host ports
notes: One MCP runtime is allowed per workspace while different workspaces may run concurrently and keep their own saved tunnel ID.

description: Each workspace shall receive a stable unique connection name such as mcp1 and reuse the same endpoint assignment after restarts
notes: Explicit --connection names are supported on first registration and cannot silently move between workspaces.

description: Status and stop shall report and clean up OpenAI tunnel local HTTP and Cloudflare publisher state
notes: Transport metadata records no bearer or tunnel secrets.

description: A workspace shall not switch between local HTTP Cloudflare publishing and OpenAI tunnel while another transport is active
notes: Changing transport requires an explicit stop first.

description: Published HTTP MCP shall pass the expected public authority to Winx host validation
notes: Winx also provides bearer authentication request limits and DNS-rebinding protections.

description: Secret directories and credential files shall reject symlink substitution and use user-only permissions
notes: Secret storage is configurable with AI_SANDBOX_SECRETS_STORAGE.

description: Sharing the sandbox home with the tunnel MCP shall be an explicit opt-in that is warned and recorded in status metadata
notes: The default keeps an isolated MCP home because the remote AI could otherwise read stored credentials and agent configuration.

description: One host-level gateway shall expose a fixed pool of stable slot endpoints that route to independent workspace HTTP MCP servers
notes: Each slot reuses the existing per-workspace Streamable HTTP backend and its host-only bearer token.

description: Slot assignments and capability tokens shall persist in host-only state with atomic flock-guarded updates and symlink rejection
notes: Registry files are 0600 under a 0700 directory and never contain bearer tokens.

description: A public request shall only reach the workspace bound to its slot and shall have no workspace-selection parameter
notes: The gateway injects the internal bearer token and strips any client Authorization header.

description: One named Cloudflare tunnel shall serve the gateway while public exposure stays disabled by default
notes: Public publishing requires --dev-insecure capability URLs until OAuth lands at the gateway.
